content:
name: ghost
networks:
    proxy:
        external: true
services:
    ghost:
        container_name: ghost
        environment:
            database__client: mysql
            database__connection__database: ${DB_DATABASE:-ghost}
            database__connection__host: ${DB_HOST:-db}
            database__connection__password: ${DB_PASSWORD:-changeme}
            database__connection__user: ${DB_USERNAME:-ghost}
            url: https://${DOMAIN:-localhost}
        expose:
            - "2368"
        image: ghost:5-alpine
        networks:
            - proxy
        restart: unless-stopped
        volumes:
            - ./data:/var/lib/ghost/content
name: ghost
